messages:
Maya S: FYI EdgeHW reported missing entitlements for some EU device usage (2026-03-21 22:00 -> 02:00 UTC). Our ledger has usage events but joins show entitlement_id=NULL for many edge batches. Could be parsing or timezone.
Ibrahim T: Hypothesis: partner switched to gzip batches last week. If batch-processor fallback sets entitlement_id=NULL on parse error that would explain it. I'll query ingest logs for gzip_error counts.
Jordan L: We rolled stricter gzip handling in v2.4; EU still has a few older processors. I'll run a replay of raw S3 batches into v2.4 (rp-4332) to reproduce.
EdgeHW Support: Client 3.3.0 enabled gzip + increased batch size. We pushed logs: https://partners.edgehw/logs/edge_batch_20260321.tar.gz. Example event: {"device_id":"edge-9922","usage_units":48,"timestamp":"2026-03-21T23:59:59+01:00","entitlement_id":"ent_EDGE_42"}
Ops Bot: Alert created TICKET-7891 for partner-ingest-edgehw-gzip-fallback.
Ibrahim T: Query result: 7 batch_ids with >100 null-entitlement events and gzip_error flagged: batch-22341, batch-22342, batch-22410, batch-22411, batch-22500, batch-22501, batch-22512.
Jordan L: Replay rp-4332 done. Of 12,000 events, 11,820 matched ledgers; 180 had entitlement_id NULL originally but parsed OK on replay -> delta 1.5% for that day's EdgeHW usage.
Maya S: 1.5% is material. EdgeHW: can you confirm those 180 are billable?
EdgeHW Support: Confirmed all 180 have usage_units>0. We'll pause billing for affected batches while you reconcile.
Maya S: Next steps: (A) Jordan run full-day replay rp-4333 and produce reconciled diff; (B) Ibrahim draft appendix with batch ids + root cause (gzip footer/parse fallback + processor mismatch); (C) I'll draft partner note: summary, mitigation (pause billing on implicated batches), timeline to fix and credit estimate.
Jordan L: rp-4333 started, ETA ~20m.
Ibrahim T: Appendix will recommend: upgrade remaining EU processors to v2.4, add realtime gzip_error metric and alert, and reprocess failed batches.
Maya S: If post-replay delta >0.5% we escalate to payments ops for a credit memo. Keeping thread open until rp-4333 completes. :memo:
